content.text: {"heavy-calm":"When you feel weighed down and quiet, the cool deep blue pools here offer somewhere to rest your eyes, while the cream path bends gently toward something further on.","mid-calm":"The flat shapes of green, tan and blue sit evenly side by side, unhurried and clean, so your eye can wander the curving white road at its own pace.","bright-calm":"Soft leaf green and warm sand tones give this poster a gentle warmth, and the looping thin line drifts across it like a relaxed doodle on a sunny afternoon.","heavy-mid":"For a thoughtful, weighty mood, the tall cream T-square and drafting triangle stand like tools for planning, a quiet reminder that heavy times can still be built through.","mid-mid":"Ruler, triangle and winding road share the page in steady balance, an everyday picture of work and direction that feels sensible without ever going dull.","bright-mid":"Hope runs right through the bold dark lettering of the title, and the white road curving upward through bright blue makes looking forward feel easy and open.","heavy-charged":"If you are wound tight, the sweeping S of the white road gives that tension somewhere to go, carrying it out of the storm toward clear blue ground.","mid-charged":"Crisp diagonals slice across rounded color fields, and the restless looping line seems to sketch itself as you watch, matching an alert mind that wants to move.","bright-charged":"Playful shapes bounce off one another in green, blue and tan, and the springy curve of the road has the lift of someone striding out happily into the future."}

The lowered helmet and drooping posture make a calm counterweight, a reflective corner beside brighter things."}

{"heavy-calm":"Against the quiet you carry, the reader in his chair offers a small refuge: an orange book held close while dark shapes loom harmlessly behind him in the blue.","mid-calm":"The boy in the rocking chair keeps reading while a ghost and a bat crowd in, a gentle reminder that stillness can hold its own beside a little mischief.","bright-calm":"Soft sky blue fills most of the sheet, and the grinning orange moon at the top keeps the spooky crowd friendly, a warm and easy October evening.","heavy-mid":"The black silhouettes of a crooked house and a looming ghost carry real weight here, yet the wide-eyed reader turns that gravity into a story worth staying with.","mid-mid":"Orange, black and blue in flat, clean shapes give this poster a steady, workmanlike balance, like an ordinary autumn night made a little more interesting by a book.","bright-mid":"That cheerful jack-o-lantern moon sets the tone, hopeful and a bit cheeky, while the boy's tidy bow tie and open book promise an easy, pleasant hour.","heavy-charged":"The tension you feel finds company in the witch streaking across the sky and the ghost rearing over the chair, drama kept playful by bold cartoon outlines.","mid-charged":"Everything leans and swoops here, from the tilted house with its startled windows to the bat's spread wings, matching a restless mind with lively, crackling shapes.","bright-charged":"The bouncing hand-drawn lettering and that grinning orange moon carry pure exuberance, a Halloween romp where even the ghosts seem to be having fun."}

{"heavy-calm":"If you are sitting with something heavy, the cream ground and steady rows of lettering offer a quiet order, a small civic promise that music will still gather people.","mid-calm":"Restful in its way, the poster stacks its words in even, unhurried lines, and the soft sage green settles the brighter red into a calm rhythm.","bright-calm":"The warm cream paper and gentle green ribbon along the left edge carry a mild cheerfulness, like an evening concert announced well ahead, nothing rushed.","heavy-mid":"For a grave mood, the deep red block letters have weight and seriousness, though they point toward shared song rather than dwelling in the dark.","mid-mid":"Here is an everyday kind of good news: tidy columns of red and green type, a date, a place, and a town planning to sing together.","bright-mid":"Hopeful and easy, the poster lists bands, choirs and orchestras down a striped banner, each word like a door opening onto another evening of music.","heavy-charged":"When things feel stormy, the bold red headline gives that energy somewhere better to go, turning tension into the anticipation of two thousand voices.","mid-charged":"Restless energy finds a match in the diagonal red and green stripes scattered with black notes, a side panel that seems to keep its own beat.","bright-charged":"Joy runs through the confident red lettering and dancing musical notes, a whole city's music week packed into one bright, celebratory sheet from 1940."}

{"heavy-calm":"The small black silhouette of a boy reaching for fruit sits in near silence against pale cream, a quiet, sorrowful moment beneath all that urgent lettering.","mid-calm":"For an unhurried mood, this offers its tension at arm's length: flat slate blue, clean cream and black, a stark design you can study slowly.","bright-calm":"Your gentle mood meets a harder story here, though the soft pile of pale round fruit in the corner keeps one tender, almost hopeful note.","heavy-mid":"The towering blue shadow of a grown man with a pistol behind a reaching boy carries the weight you feel, a grave warning about where small choices lead.","mid-mid":"Steady and clear, the poster lays out its argument in two figures and a few colors, a measured way to think about cause and consequence.","bright-mid":"Hope lives in the title's promise of planned housing, an answer offered to the shadow, a reminder that a better outcome was being built.","heavy-charged":"The tense drama you carry is here in the looming slate figure and the tilted black letters marching across it like a storm warning.","mid-charged":"Restless energy runs through the slanted lettering and the boy's outstretched arm, everything leaning forward, caught in the instant before action.","bright-charged":"Your lively mood finds a sober echo in the poster's bold, dynamic shapes and diagonal type, energy turned toward a serious cause rather than celebration."}

{"heavy-calm":"If you feel heavy and still, the books whirling around this bundled figure offer a gentle pull outward, a reminder that a quiet season can hold a good long read.","mid-calm":"The calm sea-green ground steadies all the tumbling volumes, so the motion feels like a breeze rather than a gale, easy company for an unhurried afternoon.","bright-calm":"Warm red scarf, soft green air, a figure hugging a book close: the cheer here is cozy, matching your gentle mood while the pages flutter lightly past.","heavy-mid":"Your thoughtful weight finds a lighter partner in this blowing wind of books, each spine a serious author carried along by playful gusts of white.","mid-mid":"Bold blocks of navy, red and cream keep everything clear and orderly, a steady everyday poster with just enough wind in it to keep you moving.","bright-mid":"There is easy hope in that clutched book and the scarf streaming behind, a figure walking into the month with something good to read.","heavy-charged":"If your mood runs stormy, the wind here is the friendly kind, whipping books into the air so the turbulence becomes play instead of threat.","mid-charged":"Restless energy has somewhere to go in this flurry of flying volumes and jagged white gusts, a poster built entirely on brisk forward motion.","bright-charged":"Joy whirls through every corner, red and blue books tossed skyward around a scarf snapping in the wind, a lively match for your exuberant spirit."}

{"heavy-calm":"When you feel quiet and inward, the warm cream paper and old-fashioned hand lettering offer a small, gentle nudge outward, a reminder that someone once laughed at this.","mid-calm":"The soft faded cream ground keeps things easy on the eye, even as the red script swings across it. {"heavy-calm":"When you feel quiet and inward, the steady blue field here offers a gentle counterweight, its golden lettering glowing like warm lamps in a calm room.","mid-calm":"The even rows of gold letters stack down the blue like a patient program of music, orderly and unhurried, with nothing asking you to rush.","bright-calm":"Soft gold on a wide blue ground has the warmth of an evening out, and the little lyre at the top sits there like a pleased, resting ornament.","heavy-mid":"If your mind feels weighty, this 1938 notice for a students loan fund benefit lifts it toward community: neighbors gathering, small coins spent to help someone forward.","mid-mid":"There is something reassuring in its everyday purpose, a school concert announced in clear shadowed letters, the plain business of a town keeping its music going.","bright-mid":"The curling gold lyre crowning the poster carries an easy hopefulness, like the first warm notes of a band tuning up before the lights dim.","heavy-charged":"A storm in you may find a steadier rhythm here; the firm black border and bold capitals hold everything in place like a drummer keeping time.","mid-charged":"The red band and swooping blue arch at the top have real spring in them, matching your restless energy with the feel of an overture about to start.","bright-charged":"Joy fits this one well: bright gold lettering, brassy and confident, practically sounds like a marching band striking up in Rockville Centre."}

{"heavy-calm":"The headless winged figure stands in deep brown shadow against muted sage green, and its stillness can hold your quiet without asking you to lift.","mid-calm":"Beneath the drama, the gray-green ground is soft and even, and the faint musical staff in rust floats like a slow afternoon tune you can rest inside.","bright-calm":"Brighter moods may find a gentle echo in the white highlights brushing the wing and robe, catching light like sun on stone during an unhurried hour.","heavy-mid":"A figure without a head, still pressing forward on great dark wings, carries real weight here; Byron Browne lets loss and resolve share the same body.","mid-mid":"Steady blocky lettering in white and red sits beside the striding figure, giving you a clear, ordinary rhythm of announcement and image working side by side.","bright-mid":"Hope arrives in the bold red letters of Victory Concerts, warm against the cool green, promising music offered freely to anyone who walks in.","heavy-charged":"That huge black wing sweeps across the sheet like a storm front, and the figure leans into it, giving your tension a shape that holds firm.","mid-charged":"Restless energy runs through the torn white strokes around the figure, as if wind were tearing past it, matching a mind that will not sit still.","bright-charged":"Joy here is defiant rather than giddy: red capitals ring out like brass, and the winged figure surges ahead as if the music already started."}
